questions.question: Under California Civil Code 1950.5, how many days after the tenant moves out does the landlord have to return the remaining security deposit with an itemized statement?
questions.expected_answer: No later than 21 calendar days after the tenant has vacated the premises.

questions.question: Under Civil Code 1946.2, how long must a tenant have lived in the unit before the owner needs just cause to end the tenancy, and how much relocation assistance is owed for a no-fault just cause termination?
questions.expected_answer: 12 months of continuous and lawful occupancy; relocation assistance (or a rent waiver) equal to one month of the tenant's rent.

questions.question: How many days of written notice are required to end a month-to-month tenancy?
questions.expected_answer: At least 30 days' written notice (Civil Code 1946). The habitability document also mentions 30 days' written notice, but for returning a tenant-owned refrigerator, not for ending a tenancy.

questions.question: How much can the landlord charge?
questions.expected_answer: Ambiguous. A good answer asks what kind of charge is meant or states its assumption; the clearest match is the security deposit cap of one month's rent in Civil Code 1950.5(c).
